title: AUTONOMOUS FORWARD SOCIAL-DISCOVERY AUTHORITY COURT

binding_parent.holding: AUTONOMOUS FORWARD SOCIAL DISCOVERY is target-required; MISSING_WORKLOAD_AUTHORITY is authority debt, not evidence of unnecessary capability.

core_law.data_during_search: Selects which lawful coordinates, values, conjunctions, branch paths, reversals, cotravel relations, k-way configurations, temporal changes and source disagreements emerge.

pre_search_authority_dimensions: finite or finitely constructible candidate atom universe
response topology, event multiplicity/order/set semantics and typed special states
empirical-coordinate conditioner eligibility with D10 noncollapse
predicate/composition grammar; individual permissions do not automatically compose
interaction arity/depth/complexity frontier and claimed discoverability class
algorithm coverage/pruning contract independent of implementation order
branch-membership and same-respondent cotravel identity where relevant
temporal/cross-source comparability and harmonization where relevant
negative authority including no false source joins and no demographic-to-psyche promotion
data_selected_outputs: which coordinate values form majority/minority departures
which temporal fork changes survive comparability/validation
typed valid-empty outcome when no candidate survives

named_query_only.witness: XOR income×education: each unary P(Y|coordinate) is flat while the two-way conjunction is deterministic; if the conjunction was not individually named it is never discovered.
named_query_only.target_law: Predeclare eligible atoms and bounded composition grammar, not the winning relationship.

search_everything.witness: Arbitrary columns/recodings/topologies/sources/unbounded depth with no risk-set/support/multiplicity law yields semantically invalid joins, sparse artifacts and irreproducible multiplicity-driven discoveries.
search_everything.target_law: Autonomy is data selection inside a governed finite frontier.

guarantees: order/permutation independence where semantics unordered; explicit direction where ordered
no pruning converted into semantic absence
minority/non-top reachability within declared support/completeness claim
XOR/parity reachability if interaction/higher-order family claims zero-lower-order-signal discovery
lawful conjunction reachability inside declared arity/depth frontier
rejected/pruned candidate trace or exact deterministic reconstruction where coverage audit requires it
no population discovery -> actor psyche inference

notes.exhaustive_bounded: Completeness only over an explicitly bounded lawful frontier.
notes.greedy_beam_recursive_adaptive: Lawful only relative to explicit coverage claim; parameters that change reachability are semantic replay inputs.
notes.screen_then_exact: Exact replay of survivors does not prove screened-out candidates irrelevant; screening false-negative/coverage law required.
notes.generic_evaluator: Possible authority/algorithm separation if candidate identity carries family/scope/topology/predicate/risk-set/measure/support/provenance and search controller carries coverage contract; not selected as architecture.

historical_findings.V547: Fixed predictor universe; data-selected strongest unary and exhaustive unordered pair. Useful capability law: authority bounds atoms, data selects relation. Pairs only; no full pair topology/membership; triples invisible.
historical_findings.V548: Data-selected recursive deviation search after fixed field universe. Useful capability law: recursive subgroup discovery. Historical one-deviation-path geometry not target law; alternative paths/minorities/interactions lost.
historical_findings.V549_V549b: Actual branch/answer anchors searched against eligible other responses by same respondent. Useful capability law: data-selected cotravel from exact cohort/anchor identity. Pairwise/top-k/scalar summaries not target canonical facts.
historical_findings.current_V550: Unary scan + primary-star pair search + greedy top-two recursion + unary outlier + order-sensitive pair cloud. Useful primitives, but current generic discovery authority partial/missing and coverage failures material.
historical_findings.current_V550J: Bounded governed joint configuration is positive precedent: authority selects family/components while data selects observed joint patterns. Does not authorize arbitrary new configuration families.

present_or_precedent: R1/QUC semantic/use eligibility for parts of question/coordinate candidate universe
bounded V550J joint-configuration registry and selected workload
AssociationLaneRegistry separation of candidate calculation from publication governance
partial_or_implementation_only: current greedy depth-3 top-two recursive tree
missing_generic: generic higher-order/k-way exploration frontier and validation law
generic Simpson/reversal search workload and common risk-set law
generic response-pair/k-way cotravel workload beyond bounded configs

search_families.replay: Deterministic candidate enumeration/evaluation from exact substrate+authority+algorithm version; preserve evaluated/rejected identity or a replay-equivalent trace.
Exact candidate pair identity, risk-set/measure basis, evaluator/version, and deterministic result reproduction.
Reconstruct exact joint contingency/incidence and candidate evaluation; record pruning/coverage if non-exhaustive.
Exact respondent incidence or information-equivalent joint contingency for all retained dimensions.
E0 respondent incidence or exact information-equivalent k-way contingency covering every queried dimension; deterministic candidate frontier.
Exact branch predicate/member set, parentage, candidate set/evaluations or replay-equivalent rejected trace, algorithm/version.
Full marginal and conditioned contingencies under identical declared risk-set/measure rules.
Retain/reconstruct nonmodal categories and exact subgroup support/distribution.
Same-respondent E2 incidence or information-equivalent pair contingency with exact risk-set/topology/provenance.
Exact BranchMember incidence or deterministic predicate+authority+source replay plus same-respondent response incidence.
Exact E2 k-way incidence/contingency with configuration identity and provenance.
Exact per-wave empirical facts/incidence plus harmonization/comparability/proxy provenance.
Replay each source fact independently plus exact cross-source comparison/harmonization contract.

mandatory_guarantees.permutation_order_independence: required where semantic candidate relation is unordered; D04 current cloud violates
mandatory_guarantees.minority_retention: supported minorities/non-top values remain reachable inside claimed coverage
mandatory_guarantees.rejected_candidate_traceability: required where needed to prove coverage/replay, or exact deterministic reconstruction
mandatory_guarantees.xor_parity: required if claimed interaction/higher-order family includes zero-lower-order-signal structure
mandatory_guarantees.arbitrary_lawful_conjunctions: required within authorized grammar/depth, not unlimited
mandatory_guarantees.reproducibility: required; D04 order/resume defects are counterexamples

materialization.law: Discovery may be on-demand; persistence/cache decisions are separate. Result and search must retain/reconstruct enough evidence to substantiate and replay.

reconstructibility.minimum: Respondent-bound incidence or information-equivalent exact contingency for every dimension the authorized frontier may combine, plus topology/event multiplicity, source/scope, routing/risk set, typed absence, weights/measure, predicate/branch provenance, authority/version and deterministic replay identity.

cross_source_boundary.minimum_law: Compare separately scoped source facts under explicit comparability; never false-join unrelated respondent universes or erase disagreement through naive pooling.
